authority.description: authority is the address that controls the module (defaults to x/gov unless overwritten).

params.description: params defines the x/crontask parameters to update. NOTE: All parameters must be supplied.

dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.MsgUpdateParam.title: Msg Update Params
dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.MsgUpdateParam.description: --------------------------------------------------------------------------- MsgUpdateParams --------------------------------------------------------------------------- UpdateParams defines a governance operation for updating the x/crontask module parameters. The authority defaults to the x/gov module account.

block_gas_limit.description: Maximum gas allowed for executing tasks per block

expiry_limit.description: Default expiry limit in seconds (24 hours)

max_scheduled_time.description: Maximum allowed scheduled time in seconds from task creation (24 hours)

max_expiry_delta.description: Maximum allowed delta for subscription expiry renewal (default 7 days)

dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.Params.title: Params
dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the crontask module

dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.MsgUpdateParam.title: Msg Update Params Response
dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.MsgUpdateParam.description: MsgUpdateParamsResponse defines the response structure for executing a MsgUpdateParams message.
